title: Accouchement
html_source:
Accouchement is a French word referring to childbirth/parturition (and not, as Pen. 20 c. Classics Annotated Students' Edition has it, a period spent in bed).

Etym. First attested in 1803. Borrowed from French accoucher (“to be delivered of a child, to aid in delivery”), from Old French acouchier (“to lay down, put to bed, go to bed”), from Latin ad + collocare (“to lay, put, place”). See collate.
